subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Lose heart

options.text: To be suspicious of your success
To get success by believing in yourself
To stop believing that you can succeed

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"lose heart"** means to stop believing that you can succeed or to become discouraged. (हिम्मत हार जाना)

 
 
• **Example:** After failing the exam twice, he began to lose heart and considered giving up.
 
 
 
• **"Stop believing that you can succeed"** refers to losing confidence or hope in achieving success. (यह विश्वास करना बंद कर देना कि आप सफल हो सकते हैं)
 
 
• **Example:** She lost heart after her business failed and decided to look for a job instead.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To be suspicious of your success** (आपकी सफलता के बारे में संदेह करना): Having doubts about one's own success.

 
 
• **Example:** He was always suspicious of his success, thinking it was just luck.
 
 
 
• **To get success by believing in yourself** (खुद पर विश्वास करके सफलता प्राप्त करना): Achieving success through self-confidence.
 
 
• **Example:** She got success by believing in herself and never giving up.
 
 
 
• **To believe in your success** (अपनी सफलता पर विश्वास करना): Having confidence in one's own success.
 
 
• **Example:** He always believed in his success and worked hard to achieve it.
